raw_response:

Additionally, the company demonstrates strong profitability with an operating margin of 13.8% (EBIT of 2,494M on 18,044M in revenue) and substantial accumulated retained earnings of 22,804M, indicating a consistent track record of earnings retention. These metrics are characteristic of an investment-grade issuer with low to moderate credit risk.
